releaseNotes:
SecApper Live Update v1.1.3:
• Fixed One-Time Unlock Popup Limit: Resolved window handle caching and excessive suppression timeouts. The standalone unlock modal now reliably appears every time you double-click any locked folder in Windows Explorer.
• Fast Jitter-Free Debounce: Replaced permanent dialog handle blacklisting with a short 1.5-second TTL cache, allowing seamless repeated access attempts.
• Dynamic Invalidation & Re-Lock Sync: Instantly clears suppression and refreshes the folder monitor cache as soon as a folder is locked or auto-locked.
• Standalone Double-Click Unlock Modal: Cleanly intercepts Explorer access-denied dialogs and displays the SecApper unlock modal without opening the full application window.
• Automatic Re-Lock on Window Close: When an unlocked folder's Explorer window is closed, SecApper automatically re-applies NTFS security permissions.
